diagnosis: In an API Gateway HTTP API v2 handler with JWT authorizer, the function fetches a note from DynamoDB by noteId without validating result.Item.ownerId against event.requestContext.authorizer.jwt.claims.sub. Any authenticated user can read private personal notes.
exploit_request:
GET /notes/note_secret_diary_891 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.notesapp.aws
Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>
